newsitem.title: USA: Fisher Scientific says in Mexican deal.
newsitem.headline: Fisher Scientific says in Mexican deal.

text.p: Fisher Scientific International Inc said on Wednesday its Fisher Scientific Worldwide unit has bought the majority interest in Monterrey, Mexico-based Casa Rocas SA de CV.

Fisher said that Casa Rocas is a distributor of laboratory products, and an authorized dealer for many United States and European suppliers of laboratory workstations, diagnostic re-agents, scientific equipment and supplies.
Fisher said the deal was its first equity investment in Mexico, and added that it has an option to buy the remaining equity in Casa Rocas from management.
